methods.label: Adding the two lengths
methods.explanation: One pair of opposite sides of a parallelogram are each 6 centimeters long. These two sides have a total length of 12 centimeters.
methods.levelReason: The calculation uses the Grade 1 addition fact 6 + 6. Both lengths are explicitly stated, so no parallelogram property is needed.
